Selection and sources

130 curated entries covering familiar iconographic types and named venerated icons. This is a study selection, not a measured popularity ranking. Depictions, historical accounts and theological explanations remain attributed to their named sources; original objects and later examples are distinguished.

Image sources, file licenses, and published explanations are identified on each entry.
